---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using synthetic data
---

## What happened?
Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## Reproduce
Provide steps using the bundled synthetic demo or a minimal generated fixture.

## Environment
App version, operating system, and relevant build commands.

## Checks
Do not attach patient images, identifiers, sidecars, clinical exports, credentials, private paths or production logs. Use synthetic screenshots only. For security issues, read SECURITY.md and request a private reporting channel.
